table_name: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_pago_changes()  RETURNS trigger  LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE   rec_id uuid;   payload jsonb; BEGIN   IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN     rec_id := OLD.pago_id;     payload := to_jsonb(OLD);   ELSE     rec_id := NEW.pago_id;     payload := to_jsonb(NEW);   END IF;   INSERT INTO audit_log(table_name, action, record_id, extra)   VALUES ('pago', TG_OP, rec_id, payload);   RETURN NEW; END; $function$
